item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hi, I’m Danison. I’m a Junior SWE currently working on APIs, chatbot infrastructure, and appointment automation.

I’m finishing my Bachelor’s at Sydney University, where I developed a strong interest in systems programming and algorithm design. I try to apply this in my work, building apps for diverse clients. I also enjoy collaborating with people from different fields.

Outside of work, I’m learning to snowboard and enjoy thoughtful conversations. I find meaning in curiosity and dialogue.
